name: key_f1
description: F1 of keys actually sounding vs. the song's required keys (musical accuracy)

name: key_recall
description: mean fraction of required keys actually struck each step (0-1)

name: press_shaping_score
description: reward's shaped depth credit for required keys (proxy; rewards partial presses)

name: false_press_count
description: mean number of wrong keys pressed per step

name: any_false_press_rate
description: fraction of steps with at least one wrong key (the reward's binary penalty)

name: idle_rate
description: fraction of steps with zero keys pressed (silence)

name: sustain_accuracy
description: fraction of steps the sustain pedal matched the song's target

name: mean_hand_power
description: mean total actuator power across both hands (energy proxy)

name: mean_fingering_dist
description: mean active-fingertip distance to its assigned key, m (fingering proxy)

name: forearm_collision_rate
description: fraction of steps the two forearms were colliding
